balls.text: this would have been wides down the leg side had Sharma not smacked this past short fine leg for four. Most expensive last over in any IPL (thanks Shiva for this)
the third man is up. The third man is up. This is a wide length ball, Sharma slogs, gets a thick over, over third man it goes
this is short of a length, Sharma stands tall, and lofts this well over long-on. This over has been serious damage
Sharma backs away, Hussey wants to push this wide outside off, but he has bowled this too wide
Sharma charges down, Hussey misses his length again, and gives him a high full toss, which he smacks into the second tier of the stands behind midwicket
now gets the yorker right. Sharma can't do much to it
and he tries to bowl full and fast and not let Sharma get under it, but he does get under it, and sends it for a six to long-on
well finished. A yorker, gets just the single
wide half-volley, can't time it, gets a single off the inside half of the bat
Sharma charges, PK follows him, cramps him up, Sharma scoops this low full toss, but it doesn't carry to wide long-on
Driven to extra cover, collected on the half-volley, but Pollard sends him back. They don't take the single even on the overthrow
full, middle and leg, driven to deep midwicket. PK and KP are standing next to each other and talking. Ends with a pat on PK's head
drilled. Praveen Kumar saves his life. This is just short of being a yorker, and he has smashed this back at PK, who ducks for cover. One bounce for four
Sharma backs away, Gony stays full and wide, and beats the wide
wide full toss, would have been called a wide, had Pollard not toe-ended this to long-off
good bouncer on the free hit. Oh no, this is too high. Called a wide. The free hit stays

another played-on. That's three out of four. And Pollard has managed to drag a wide full toss onto the stumps. Hang on. This could be a no-ball. There is nothing in it. One angle says nothing is behind the line, the other says there could be a hair behind. I would hate to be the third umpire here. Called no-ball. This could be a game-changing delivery
Pollard shapes up for the scoop behind square, Gony goes full and wide, wide of that white guide line, and beats Pollard. Not called a wide. I like that call
low full toss, dragged to deep midwicket for one
slower ball, but nearly a half-volley, and Sharma drives inside-out. Not the best of connections, but it has cleared long-off
short of a length, middle and leg, heaved away to deep square leg for one
on a length, on off, driven to long-on for one
yorker now, squeezed out for a single

this is not going Mahmood's way. After that inside-edged four comes the top-edged six. Mahmood does everything right here. Follows Sharma, who is backing away, gets this bouncer over the shoulder, but when top edges fly for sixes, what do you do Jack?
short of a length, into the hips, Pollard misses, gets a leg-bye
sets himself up for the midwicket slog, mis-hits this shortish delivery to midwicket for one
on a length, outside off, Sharma drives, gets an inside edge that goes between the stumps and the keeper for four. Unfortunate result, but should he bowling length?
slower ball, really full, nearly a yorker. Pollard is done in by it, and defends this back
looks to cut this short ball, but finds point
slower ball, full, on leg, Sharma defends it to leg for one
that's clobbered away. Sharma's 100th IPL six. Only two others have reached there. This is short of a length, but he stands upright and smashes this over midwicket. Way into the stands
Sharma premeditates but executes well. Backs away, gets under a length ball, and lofts it over extra cover
on a length, on off, holds its line, hits the outside half of the bat for one
short of a length, widish, Sharma drives away from the body, and is beaten. Just nine off the last two overs
short of a length, on off, pushed to mid-off for one
dug in short, Pollard doesn't pull because it has got about shoulder high
short of a length, steered away to third man for one
short of a length, angling in, looks to work it to leg, is beaten, but gets the leg-bye
short of a length, wide, steered away to third man
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on. Just five off
full and fast again, pushed to point
short of a length, on off, punched to long-off for one
Would Gilly have made this stumping? Full, Rohit plays over it, deflectes off his pad, and Gurkeerat fails to collect it
he has nearly holed out to a full toss. Hit too casually, but it doesn't carry to wide long-on
full, flat, on leg, dug out for one
flat and quick again, defended back to him
flatter, on off, defended. Chawla had tossed it up after Smith hit the six. Not now
and he goes boom first ball. Full, on off, and he has smashed this straight back over his head for a flat six. "Kassa kai Mumbai," says Pollard
full, on off, driven to long-on for one
tossed up wide, away from Smith's reach, and he can't reach it properly. It skies off the toe end for long-on to take an easy catch
Smith crosses 100-run strike rate with a brutal hit off Chawla. On a length, on off, slogged away 98 metres into the stands
fullish, on off, driven to long-off
pushed into the off side for one
wide length ball, he has square-driven this to the left of Chawla at deep cover. Chawla misfields at deep cover. He is a worse fielder than a few 40 year olds in India
gets an inside edge onto the pad now. Takes a single
chipped over extra cover. Smart shot. Gets under a length ball, doesn't want to hit a six, just clears the infield
short-arm pull. From middle and leg. Through square leg. That's his trademark
gets an inside edge on the drive, goes to long leg for one
goes back, steers a length ball to third man
superb delivery. Short of a length, just outside off, then seams away against the angle. Beaten
on a length, off, pushed to straight extra cover, takes the single. He was a goner had Shaun Marsh hit
short of a length, outside off, steered away to third man
short of a length, punched to mid-off for one
wide down the leg side. The run rate reaches six now
short, wide, cut away, square of deep cover. Gets four for this
defended off the front foot
Vohara has dropped a sitter while sitting down at deep midwicket. Pulled straight him, it dips on him a touch, but it is still shin-high and should have been taken
short and wide again, but nearly a chop-on. Gets a single off the bottom edge
short and wide, cut away, gets a single to deep point
drilled. Absolutely drilled. Full, middle and leg, gentle, the umpire and the non-striker are still alive
this one seams away a touch from a length outside off. Beaten
short of a length, outside ff, rides the bounce, steers it square of third man for a couple
this short ball gets big on him, but the mis-hit pull doesn't carry to deep midwicket
Smith pulls and misses. This is perhaps not short enough
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover
left alone outside off
short of a length, outside off, punched away, straight to point. Smith is 7 off 18. He is not letting Mumbai miss Tendulkar
stays short of a length, bunted into the leg side for one

played on. Second of the night. Short of a length, gets big on him, Karthik is looking to get behind and defend, but he is very much done in by the pace. Hit on the toe end even before the bat has completely gone up
swiped across the line but it is effective. Plants the front foot down and sends this through wide long-on for four
short of a length, on off, pushed to point with an open face
starts with a good ball with extra bounce. Karthik tries to run this fine, and is beaten by the bounce
looks to pull, but this is not short enough, and is hit on the thigh pad
wide length ball, he tries to loft this over mid-off, but is beaten by the movement away
down the wicket to pull this shortish delivery for a single to deep midwicket
on a length, just outside off, defended off the front foot
short of a length, outside off, punched to deep cover for one
short of a length, into the pads, a bit too quick for him, but they take a leg-bye
stays back, plays with soft hands, gets a single to point. Miller keeps the ball with him this time
pushed into the off side for a single
that's a five. Miller keeps missing, but this time no one is backing up. This is an easy single, but Miller goes at the striker's end, and finds the gap between mid-on and midwicket
defended off the back foot, in the gap on the off side, gets a single
nearly run out. Smith refuses to respect Karthik's call who is running to the danger end as the ball has been hit to point. Karthik is left stranded, but Miller's throw misses
good outswinger. Just short of a length, just outside off, beats the edge as Smith pushes at it
another inswinger, pushed to mid-off for a single
good inswinger, headed towards top of off, defended back to him
down the wicket again, beaten by movement in, gets a leg-bye
Karthik unfurls. Downs the wicket, converts this into a length ball, and plays a pick-up shot over long leg for a flat six
short of a length, angling into the pads. Too straight with fine leg up. Nudged away past him for four
more shape away from him, hits the outside half of the bat, bounces in front of slip
this one swings away a bit, guided to third man for one
down the wicket, shortish from Mahmood, ends up defending to mid-off
short, chest-high, rolls the wrists on the pull, gets a single
short of a length, on off, defended back to him
pushes forward to push this to third man for one
Mahmood is swinging it still. Squares him up a bit. Defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man for one
left alone outside off
big inswinger, but slips just down the leg side. This is harsh, because he beat him around off after he had moved across, and missed the leg stump by not much
You can't hear a pin drop at Wankhede because nobody has gone quiet there. Looks to drive on the up, gets an inside edge, onto the pad, then the stumps. Praveen is happy, Tendulkar is not
Piyush Chawla is conceding easy singles at mid-on. They are picking on him
lovely outswinger, squares him up, and then deviates away after beating the bat. For a moment, I thought he had edged it
length ball, holds its line in front of off and middle, beats the inside edge, but is bouncing over
full, on off, defended solidly to mid-off
dug in short, on off, he drops his wrists and sways out of its line
short, wide, slow, cut away in front of square, between cover-point and cover
short of a length, on off, defended to leg
nicely played. Pushed for four. Covers the swing, then opens the face, places it between point and cover-point
starts with an outswinger, and is left alone outside off
and slips in the big inswinger now, and Smith has not picked this at all. However, it is headed down the leg side
outswinger, starts just outside off, left alone
short of a length, pushed to mid-on, picks on Chawla, who is slow. But Tendulkar has also run straight down the centre of the wicket
stays on a length, on off, shaping away a bit, defended
on a length, middle and leg, pushed to leg, says no to the single
short of a length, on off, pushed to mid-off, takes a single

another full toss. Is this a poor over or what? However, this time PK doesn't connect well and slices it for a catch to Tendulkar at point. And this time they are checking the height for the no-ball. They could have done this two balls ago too, and carried out justice. However, Kulkarni is fine with this one. And how lucky he is. Any more bat on this, and it was going for four
doesn't matter last ball. Had Kulkarni been taken off, how would PK have got a juicy full toss on the pads to send flying over midwicket. One-handed that too. PK has nearly pulled off a heistan

another beamer. He should be out of the attack. Oh no. They haven't called it. That is chest high. PK has a chat with Asad Rauf. That is a poor call from Rauf. Atrocious umpiring. As is the IPL standard. Not surprised

Kulkarni has missed this. Low full toss, dug out towards long-on, they are always running two, but they are both slow. Awana began late. Not to blame Kulkarni, but this is nearly a half-volley for him, and he fails to collect it
another slower bouncer, but this is too high, and it is called a wide
slower short ball, PK has not picked this at all, and is way early into it, and is beaten
gets another full toss, but he has missed out. He has mis-hit it straight to extra cover. Doesn't run for it
beamer, and what's more Tendulkar has misfielded at point. That's three runs without a ball bowled. And Kulkarni is on a warning
defended solidly to cover, PK declines the single. Seventeen to get off the last over. Only one wicket in hand. He might have to do this in boundaries
moves right across this time, was dead in front, but gets the bat down in time to take a single to fine leg
what a hit. Gayle has never hit Malinga for a six in the IPL, but PK has. Makes room, and this time he gets a full ball to get under, and lofts him over long-off
wants to loft this down the ground, but is beaten outside off
backs away, and Malinga slips this in full and just outside off to beat him
flicked away off the toes, chipped over midwicket for two. Sharma gives it a sensational chase, though, and dives for it. He could have hurt himself there
dug in short, no room, tucks him up. Gets a dot in

hardly ever seen Tendulkar celebrate a catch that way. Full and straight, Miller makes room to go over cover, but ends up slicing it. It is swerving away, Tendulkar covers that swerve well and takes the catch. But wait for the reaction. He looks skywards, and keeps clinching his fists for a while before letting the ball go in half anger
Miller is setting up a thriller. Length ball again. Miller stands tall and steady. And lofts it over wide long-on for six. Clean as a whistle
slower ball, this time he bunts it sufficiently wide of cover to take the single
oh what a hit. Forget the single. PK has smacked this. Makes room, gets beside a short ball, and smacks this over cover
PK wants the single after defending off the back foot, but he has played this straight to short cover

Miller keeps them alive. Kulkarni wants to be hit for a six otherwise there is no reason to keep bowling length to Miller, who succeeds this time in sending him deep into the stand behind deep midwicket. What's more? It's a fifty for Miller
Chawla is gone. Makes room to pull, Rayudu comes charging in front deep midwicket and takes this shin high
slower short ball, Miller is early into the pull, gloves it behind the wicket, Karthik goes leaping in their, but can't quite hold on to the catch
ramped away, but for the tailender third man is fine, and keeps them down to one
DK is lucky again. Another length ball, but has been hit straight to long-off for one
gets a length ball, looks to hit this over midwicket, but gets an inside edge onto the pad. DK is lucky to get away with this one
yorker now, dug out back at him
Chawla has smoked this one. Maybe they should stop bowling slower balls to tailenders. He has picked this one early, and smashed it back over Malinga's head
driven back hard at him, Malinga sticks his hand out, but is lucky doesn't get a touch on the ball. Single to long-on
wide down the leg side
Rohit Sharma has saved three runs at mid-off. This is drilled hard to his right, but he makes a full-length diving save
yorker, on the pads, concedes just the leg-bye
full and straight, driven to long-off for one
driven to long-on for one
short of a length, quick, 143ks, too good for Chwla who is beaten by the pace
wide down the leg side
backs away and mis-hits this short ball wide of long-on for two
bouncer, on off, beaten on the pull
placed wide of long-on, they want two, but they cannot take Pollard on
short of a length, on the stumps, placed wide of deep midwicket for two
Harbhajan gets another. Another doosra, Gony tries to slog it, edges it through to Karthik
another doosra, hits Gony's pad, but it is pitched outside leg from round the stumps
doosra, beats Gony who is looking to bunt this to leg for one
full, middle and leg, driven to leg for one
another falls. Mahmood looks to flick, but is early into it, and gets a healthy leading edge towards the square-leg umpire. Enough time for Karthik to run there and complete the catch
short, fast, beats his cut
length ball, angling away, beats his push
lovely shot. Down the wicket, takes this on the half-volley, and smashes it flat over Pollard's head for a flat six. This was bowled from behind the stumps
full, into the pads, helped away for a single
length ball, middle and leg, pushed wide of square leg for one
on a length, middle and leg, nonchalantly lofted over midwicket for six
angling into the pads, pushed away for one
length ball, on the pads, worked away for one
worked to short fine leg
down the wicket to push this to extra cover
full toss, driven to long-on for one
missed run-out. Bunted to the next pitch, and goes for a run, and is rightly sent back. Karthik misses by inches
turned to short fine leg for one
umpire Asad Rauf shows quick reflexes to save his life here. This has been smashed back at him, and he is on his backside and lets it go for four. He is asking for a helmet now
pushed into the leg side
driven down to long-off for one
this one doesn't turn, beats the inside edge as he drives, but bounces over the stumps and beats DK too
flighted, middle and leg, defended back to him
down the wicket to push this to deep midwicket
flat length ball, middle and off, pushed to leg
tossed up outside off, defended off the front foot
on a length, outside off, pushed wide of point for one
ugly swipe across the line, gets a healthy leading edge to sky this to cover for an easy catch
driven down the ground
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
driven to long-off
defends this off the front foot
this one won't clear Johnson. Hussey us gone. Can't quite get under this, and smashes this straight down long-on's throat. Johnson makes no mistake
driven to long-off for one
Pollard would have taken this? Miller goes inside-out with a flat six over long-off, and mind you, Johnson has put in a good effort by jumping high. Misses by inches
full, middle and leg, placed wide of deep midwicket for two
full, on off, driven to long-off
turning into the pads, nudged away for one
worked into the leg side for a single
length ball, turning in, bunted into the leg side for one
full, middle and leg, driven to long-on
short of a length, pushed wide of long-on for two
mis-hit towards long-off, but it desn't carry
turns into the pads, beats the inside edge
looks to work this to leg, gets a leading edge to off
short of a length, middle and leg, defended to square leg
down the wicket, beaten in the flight, but he drags it over midwicket for four

Pollard you beauty. Polly kaka has done it again. Marsh has hit flat over his head, but not quite. Pollard is right back at the fence, leaps in the air, pulls this off one-handed, but the amazing this thing is how he arrests the momentum that comes from arching back in the jump, and stays about three inches inside the fence. he is full stretch. This is amazing
dug in short, looking to upper-cut it, beaten by the extra bounce
half-volley, outside off, he backs away, clears his front leg, and lofts this over mid-off for a six. This lands on the rope
misfielded by Ojha now. Cut to point, just short of him, but Ojha doesn't get his body behind it, and lets it through
and he has still pierced it. Short of a length, not too wide, but he has cut this between cover-point and cover
short of a length, just outside off, cut to the right of third man for one
short of a length, outside off, steered to third man for one
crunched away. This is short, into the body, but doesn't quite have the sting behind it. Hussey backs away and pulls this to deep midwicket
full, widish, pushed to point. Pollard misfields to allow a single
dug in short, looks to pull, gets a bottom edge for a single
gets under a length ball, goes inside-out, over mid-off
full, on off, pushed towards mid-off for one
full toss on the pads, clipped away for four through square leg
Hussey gives him the charge and can't time this shortish ball at all
short of a length, on off, pushed to point
short, not wide, but Hussey has cut this nonetheless. Pollard has dived and got a hand to it at point
short of a length, on off, defended off the back foot
short of a length, outside off, pushed to point
length ball , wide, pushed past mid-off for four
short of a length, backs away to steer it away to third man
much ado about nothing. There were some 1000 replays with that run-out but there is no doubt regarding this. Full and wide, he drives loosely and limply, and lobs a catch to point

full, swinging away, squeezed out, to the left of third man, they take on Kulkarni's arm, take the third, but Kulkarni's throw is quick, and reaches Karthik on the half-volley. He removes the bail, we go up to the third umpire. This is a close call. He might have got a smidgeon of the bat over the line
full, into the pads, flicked away, straight to short fine leg
wide down the leg side
short of a length, into the ribs, tucked away for a single
full, into the pads, misses on the shot, concedes a leg-bye

similar ball, Singh still has no clue about it. Off stumps out of the ground. The slower ball again, dipping on him, nearly a yorker, squeezes under the bat again, and this time it is straighter and hits the off stump
slower ball, nearly a yorker, Singh has no idea whatsoever about this. Squeezes under his bat
short of a length, middle and leg, worked to leg, but can't beat square leg
quick outswinger, squares him up, takes the edge, but goes wide of slip. Can't drive at it, swinging just outside off
slower ball, offcutter, runs this down to third man for one
Marsh gets a swinging ball into the toes first up from Malinga. Keeps it out
length ball on middle, blocked back towards the bowler
back of a length ball outside off, flies off the outside edge down to Dhawal Kulkarni at third man, that ball travelled quickly
a length ball just outside off, defended off the front foot
short of length ball outside off, muscled towards extra cover where Rayudu moves across in a jiffy to cut it off
short of length ball that came on to him quicker than he expected, somehow gets bat on it and defends to the leg side
full toss, on off, a sweet little offering, and he has eased this through cover for four
Johnson starts with a wide delivery well outside off
